name: Barley Swine

menus.name: Chef's Tasting Menu
menus.note: Whole table must take it; traditional pairing $75–85, premier pairing about $135–145; $150 on Formula 1 weekend (22–25 October); $30 off for 4:30–5pm Sunday bookings; 20% gratuity added

bookingOpens: Online on Tock, with a $50 deposit per person that comes off the bill. Parties of five or more book by email (reservations@barleyswine.com).
cancellation: Deposits are non-refundable. With at least 48 hours' notice by email to reservations@barleyswine.com, a booking can be rescheduled once.
walkIns: Every seat, bar included, is booked; on the day, call to ask if a seat has come free.
groups: Email for five or more; up to 16 without hiring the whole restaurant.
dressCode: No dress code: jeans and shorts are fine. Guests are asked not to wear clothing that sheds glitter, or strong perfume.
children: Children are welcome but count in the booking, deposit included. There is no children's menu, only the tasting menu, and they should be able to sit through a meal of about two hours.
duration: About two hours; tables are booked for 2½ hours.
